snippet.title: Project Hypnagogia — Announcement Trailer (2022)
snippet.description:
When a nightmare refuses to end.
Explore Project Hypnagogia on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1499010/

Watch the original 2022 announcement trailer for Project Hypnagogia.

A scientist’s experiment turns the subject’s deepest fears into reality. As dreams and waking life blur together, finding a way out becomes the only goal.

Subscribe to Arkuda Inc. for official trailers, gameplay and development updates.
